+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = r'''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.10"
+author: Ruckus Wireless (@Commscope)
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Manage syslog destinations and logging options on Ruckus ICX switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or option to manage.
+    choices: [on, host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, facility]
+    type: str
+  name:
+    description: IPv4/IPv6 address or hostname for a host destination.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a host destination.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility, or null to clear the configured facility.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Severity level or list of levels for buffered logging.
+    type: raw
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings to manage in one call.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Whether the configuration should be present or absent.
+    type: str
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare with running configuration; defaults to the environment setting.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = r'''
+- name: Configure logging destinations
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - { dest: host, name: 192.0.2.10, udp_port: 514 }
+      - { dest: host, name: 2001:db8::10, udp_port: 6514 }
+      - { facility: local7 }
+- name: Disable console logging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: console
+    state: absent
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+'''
+
+import re
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+LEVELS = ('alerts', 'critical', 'debugging', 'emergencies', 'errors',
+          'informational', 'notifications', 'warnings')
+DESTINATIONS = ('on', 'host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'facility')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    """Count non-null values in a mapping, optionally restricted to keys."""
+    if param is None:
+        param = check.keys()
+    return sum(1 for key in param if check.get(key) is not None)
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for obj in lst:
+        if obj.get('name') == name:
+            return obj
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    want_levels = set(want.get('level') or [])
+    have_levels = set(have.get('level') or [])
+    return want_levels - have_levels, have_levels - want_levels
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    """Validate simple (parameter, value, required parameters) rules."""
+    for key, value, required in spec or []:
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            missing = [item for item in required if param.get(item) is None]
+            if missing:
+                module.fail_json(msg="%s is required when %s is %s" % (', '.join(missing), key, value))
+    dest = param.get('dest')
+    if dest == 'host' and not param.get('name'):
+        module.fail_json(msg="name is required when dest is 'host'")
+    if dest == 'buffered' and not param.get('level'):
+        module.fail_json(msg="level is required when dest is 'buffered'")
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest != 'host':
+        return None
+    match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest != 'host':
+        return None
+    match = re.search(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+(?:ipv6\s+)?([^\s]+)', line)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.search(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+ipv6\s+', line))
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    common = module.params
+    entries = common.get('aggregate') or [common]
+    result = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        obj = {key: entry.get(key, common.get(key)) for key in
+               ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')}
+        obj['state'] = obj['state'] or common.get('state') or 'present'
+        check_required_if(module, required_if, obj)
+        if count_terms(obj, ('dest', 'facility')) == 0 or (obj['dest'] not in DESTINATIONS and obj.get('facility') is None):
+            module.fail_json(msg="dest must be one of: %s, or specify facility" % ', '.join(DESTINATIONS))
+        if obj['dest'] == 'host':
+            obj['addr6'] = bool(validate_ip_v6_address(obj['name']))
+        else:
+            obj['name'] = None
+            obj['udp_port'] = None
+            obj['addr6'] = False
+        if obj['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            val = obj.get('level')
+            obj['level'] = set(val if isinstance(val, (list, tuple, set)) else [val])
+            invalid = obj['level'] - set(LEVELS)
+            if invalid:
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered level: %s' % ', '.join(sorted(invalid)))
+        elif isinstance(obj.get('level'), str):
+            obj['level'] = {obj['level']} if obj['level'] else set()
+        result.append(obj)
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    compare = module.params.get('check_running_config', True)
+    config = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging'], compare=compare) or ''
+    objects = []
+    enabled_levels = set()
+    disabled_levels = set()
+    facility = None
+    logging_on = True
+    for raw in config.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line == 'no logging on':
+            logging_on = False
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            logging_on = True
+        elif line == 'logging facility':
+            facility = None
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+        elif line.startswith('logging host '):
+            name = parse_name(line, 'host')
+            if name:
+                objects.append({'dest': 'host', 'name': name, 'addr6': parse_address(line, 'host'),
+                                'udp_port': parse_port(line, 'host'), 'state': 'present'})
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                enabled_levels.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                disabled_levels.add(level)
+                enabled_levels.discard(level)
+        elif line in ('logging console', 'logging persistence', 'logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = {'logging console': 'console', 'logging persistence': 'persistence',
+                    'logging enable rfc5424': 'rfc5424'}[line]
+            objects.append({'dest': dest, 'state': 'present'})
+        elif line in ('no logging console', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = {'no logging console': 'console', 'no logging persistence': 'persistence',
+                    'no logging enable rfc5424': 'rfc5424'}[line]
+            objects.append({'dest': dest, 'state': 'absent'})
+    objects.append({'dest': 'on', 'state': 'present' if logging_on else 'absent'})
+    objects.append({'dest': 'facility', 'facility': facility if facility is not None else 'user', 'state': 'present'})
+    objects.append({'dest': 'buffered', 'level': enabled_levels, 'disabled': disabled_levels, 'state': 'present'})
+    return objects
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want_list, have_list = updates
+    commands = []
+    for want in want_list:
+        dest = want.get('dest')
+        state = want.get('state', 'present')
+        if want.get('facility') is not None or dest is None:
+            desired_facility = want.get('facility')
+            have_facility = next((obj.get('facility') for obj in have_list if obj.get('dest') == 'facility'), 'user')
+            if state == 'absent' or desired_facility is None:
+                if have_facility != 'user' or any(x.get('dest') == 'facility' and x.get('facility') is None for x in have_list):
+                    commands.append('no logging facility')
+            elif desired_facility != have_facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % desired_facility)
+            continue
+
+        matching = [item for item in have_list if item.get('dest') == dest]
+        if dest == 'host':
+            named = search_obj_in_list(want.get('name'), matching)
+            exact = named if named and named.get('addr6') == want.get('addr6') and (
+                want.get('udp_port') is None or named.get('udp_port') == str(want['udp_port'])) else None
+            if exact is None:
+                exact = next((item for item in matching if item.get('name') == want.get('name') and
+                              item.get('addr6') == want.get('addr6') and
+                              (want.get('udp_port') is None or item.get('udp_port') == str(want['udp_port']))), None)
+            if state == 'present' and exact is None:
+                stale = [item for item in matching if item.get('name') == want.get('name') and
+                         item.get('addr6') == want.get('addr6')]
+                for item in stale:
+                    old_port = item.get('udp_port')
+                    suffix = ' udp-port %s' % old_port if old_port else ''
+                    commands.append('no logging host%s %s%s' % (' ipv6' if item.get('addr6') else '', item['name'], suffix))
+                ipv6 = ' ipv6' if want.get('addr6') else ''
+                port = ' udp-port %s' % want['udp_port'] if want.get('udp_port') is not None else ''
+                commands.append('logging host%s %s%s' % (ipv6, want['name'], port))
+            elif state == 'absent':
+                targets = [item for item in matching if item.get('name') == want.get('name') and
+                           item.get('addr6') == want.get('addr6') and
+                           (want.get('udp_port') is None or item.get('udp_port') == str(want['udp_port']))]
+                for item in targets:
+                    port = want.get('udp_port') or item.get('udp_port')
+                    suffix = ' udp-port %s' % port if port else ''
+                    commands.append('no logging host%s %s%s' % (' ipv6' if item.get('addr6') else '', item['name'], suffix))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = next((item for item in matching if item.get('level') is not None), {'level': set()})
+            current_levels = set(current.get('level') or set())
+            levels = set(want.get('level') or set())
+            if state == 'absent':
+                levels = set()
+            adds, removes = diff_in_list({'level': levels}, {'level': current_levels})
+            commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(adds))
+            commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(removes))
+        elif dest == 'on':
+            enabled = any(item.get('dest') == 'on' and item.get('state') == 'present' for item in have_list)
+            if state == 'present' and not enabled:
+                commands.append('logging on')
+            elif state == 'absent' and enabled:
+                commands.append('no logging on')
+        elif dest in ('console', 'persistence', 'rfc5424'):
+            present = any(item.get('dest') == dest and item.get('state') == 'present' for item in matching)
+            command = {'console': 'logging console', 'persistence': 'logging persistence',
+                       'rfc5424': 'logging enable rfc5424'}[dest]
+            if state == 'present' and not present:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and present:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    item_spec = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS), name=dict(type='str'),
+                     udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'),
+                     level=dict(), state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    argument_spec = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS), name=dict(type='str'),
+                         udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'), level=dict(),
+                         aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=item_spec),
+                         state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    required_if = [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, required_if)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    result = {'changed': bool(commands), 'commands': commands}
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
